## Overview
**Anbennar - Proper 2K UI** is a patch that makes [Proper 2K UI Enhanced](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=3290499798) work with [Anbennar](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1385440355).

In short: Anbennar likes breaking UI mods, Proper 2K UI likes making EU4 readable, and this mod forces them to get along.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Uf8Z21n.png)

## Required Mods
- [Anbennar](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1385440355)
- [Proper 2K UI Enhanced](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=3290499798)

## FAQ

### What load order should I use?
It does not matter. You cannot really control it from the launcher anyway, even if Paradox lets you pretend otherwise.

The only real way to influence load order is through properly set mod dependencies. If that is not done, EU4 resolves conflicts alphabetically. A beats Z. Dwarf law.

### Is it compatible with X?
No idea.
Maybe yes. Maybe no. Maybe EU4 will explode in a very specific and creative way.

If you find an incompatibility, report it and I will see if I can patch it.

### What is that little dwarf head on the thumbnail?
If you check the mod's GitHub page, you will notice the repository belongs to Happy Dwarf Team.

I like dwarves.
I like being happy.
I am, in fact, a happy dwarf myself.
